messages:
deploybot: Deploybot started rollout for release v1.14.2 -> orbit (canary 10%) at 2026-03-18T14:22:57Z. slot=4872

alice: seeing elevated tail latency in eu-zone, +120ms p99 on text-gen. alert firing? @dmitri

ben: same here in telemetry — spike lines up with canary traffic. p99 up from 220ms -> 340ms

carla: can we pause the rest of the rollout? don't want to blast the rest of fleet if canary's unhappy

dmitri: triggering emergency hold. @deploybot pause rollout and pin canary to v1.14.2-canary-2

deploybot: rollout paused. remaining slots blocked. pin applied: v1.14.2-canary-2. Notifying release owners and oncall.

ben: collecting traces now. looks like kvcache eviction storm on worker-03. excerpt below:
```
[worker-03] 14:23:02 WARN kvcache evict_l2: miss_rate=0.72, evict_cycles=4800
[worker-03] 14:23:03 ERR kernel: kvcache_l2_shard0: unexpected eviction backlog
```

alice: ops — would you prefer rolling back canary image while we triage? lower blast radius

carla: +1 to rollback canary only. keep the hold for the rest. @ben @dmitri ok?

ben: agree. initiating canary rollback to v1.14.1. @deploybot run rollback-canary slot=4872 target=v1.14.1

deploybot: acknowledged. rollback started for slot=4872 -> v1.14.1. ETA ~2m. will post progress.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0318-47 (P2) — paging oncall and recording timeline.

dmitri: after rollback completes, run smoke tests and validate kvcache metrics. if green, requeue with much smaller canary and longer observation window.

alice: propose new window: 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z UTC, canary 5%, 30m observation, staggered increments. CC @carla for release notes

carla: will update release ticket and changelog with rollback rationale and next window. assigning requeue owner to @carla.

deploybot: rollback complete. slot=4872 now serving v1.14.1. health checks passing. hold persists for remaining rollout.

ben: digging deeper — regression introduced by kvcache kernel tweak in v1.14.2 (L2 eviction heuristics). sending patch to runtime team for review.

dmitri: thanks. schedule postmortem and link to incident. for release calendar, requeue owner set; we will only unpin after postmortem signoff.

carla: requeue scheduled at 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z UTC (per alice). updating release notes and customer-facing changelog now.

alice: thanks everyone. will wait for postmortem link before closing this thread. :thumbsup:

deploybot: note for audit: pinned version remains v1.14.2-canary-2. To unpin: `/deploybot unpin slot=4872`
